field_validation.release_gate: All reconnect/session-boundary scenarios must be pass for every supported profile before release approval.

roadmap_stress_matrix.source: docs/fw-roadmap.txt section 18 TEST MATRIX and phase 8 hardening goals
roadmap_stress_matrix.release_gate: All required stress cases must have fresh pass evidence for each applicable supported profile before production firmware release approval.
roadmap_stress_matrix.evidence_policy: Record automated test names, firmware artifact identifiers, physical board/profile, duration or fault-injection method, observed result, and recovery state. Secret-bearing provisioning payloads and Wi-Fi credentials must be redacted.

categories.title: OTA and Recovery Faults
categories.applicability: endpoint and recovery firmware on every supported board profile

required_cases.title: Normal OTA success
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint installs a valid signed artifact, reboots, marks the image valid after startup self-tests, and reconnects with the same endpoint id.

required_cases.title: Corrupt image rejection
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint rejects the artifact before activation and keeps running the previous image.

required_cases.title: Wrong-board image rejection
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint rejects artifacts whose board profile, SoC, flash geometry, PSRAM, or partition schema do not match the running profile.

required_cases.title: Signature failure rejection
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint rejects unsigned or incorrectly signed firmware metadata before download or install.

required_cases.title: Power loss during OTA download
required_cases.evidence: Device boots the previous valid image, removes partial download state, and reports the failed update.

required_cases.title: Power loss during OTA flash write
required_cases.evidence: Device boots the previous valid image or recovery app, and the interrupted slot is not marked valid.

required_cases.title: Crash before image validation
required_cases.evidence: Bootloader rollback returns to the previous valid image and firmware reports rollback status.

required_cases.title: Network unavailable during validation
required_cases.evidence: Local startup self-tests can mark a good image valid without falsely rolling back because Core is temporarily offline.

required_cases.title: Both OTA slots invalid, recovery still boots
required_cases.evidence: Recovery app starts, exposes safe diagnostics, and can install a valid main firmware image.

categories.title: Model-Bundle Faults
categories.applicability: wake and Stop model bundles on internal A/B banks and SD-backed model directories

required_cases.title: Valid model-bundle update
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint stages, verifies, test-loads, activates, and reports the new wake/Stop bundle.

required_cases.title: Corrupt bundle rejection
required_cases.evidence: Hash, manifest, or test-load failure keeps the previous active bundle.

required_cases.title: Wrong-SoC bundle rejection
required_cases.evidence: Compatibility checks reject bundles outside the current SoC, partition schema, board profile, or model API range.

required_cases.title: Power loss during model download
required_cases.evidence: Partial staged bundle is cleaned or ignored and the endpoint remains wake-capable.

required_cases.title: Power loss before active pointer switch
required_cases.evidence: Previous active bundle remains selected after reboot.

required_cases.title: Failure after active pointer switch
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint rolls back to the previous compatible bundle or embedded fallback.

required_cases.title: Application rollback with newer incompatible model bundle
required_cases.evidence: Older firmware ignores incompatible mutable bundles and selects a compatible previous or embedded model.

required_cases.title: Embedded fallback model operation
required_cases.evidence: Wake and Stop detection still initialize when mutable model storage is missing or invalid.

categories.title: Storage and Removable Media Faults
categories.applicability: NVS, model partitions, mutable bundle storage, and SD-backed display profiles

required_cases.title: Corrupted NVS recovery
required_cases.evidence: Device enters a safe provisioning or recovery state without exposing secrets.

required_cases.title: Corrupted model partition
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint rejects corrupt model storage and selects previous-compatible or embedded fallback models.

required_cases.title: Corrupt SD filesystem
required_cases.evidence: Display-capable endpoints boot with embedded fallback UI/audio and report SD diagnostics.

required_cases.title: SD removal and remount behavior
required_cases.evidence: Runtime removal degrades gracefully, stops SD-backed asset use, and remounts cleanly when reinserted.

categories.title: Hardware and Audio Behavior
categories.applicability: board-specific audio, controls, display/touch, storage, radio, and status outputs

required_cases.title: PSRAM allocation and sustained use
required_cases.evidence: Long-running voice, playback, and UI paths do not exhaust or fragment PSRAM beyond profile thresholds.

required_cases.title: Microphone and audio-channel validation
required_cases.evidence: Captured channels, sample rate, gain, and VAD input mapping match the board profile.

required_cases.title: Speaker output
required_cases.evidence: Tones and TTS playback are audible, correctly routed, and report playback telemetry.

required_cases.title: Mute and button input
required_cases.evidence: Hardware mute, action, stop, rotary, or touch controls match the board profile without leaking audio while muted.

required_cases.title: LED, display, and touch state behavior
required_cases.evidence: Status outputs cover boot, idle, listening, thinking, replying, error, muted, disconnected, OTA, and recovery states.

required_cases.title: Wi-Fi/radio reconnect
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint reconnects after AP loss, backend restart, and normal power-cycle without duplicate sessions.

required_cases.title: Wake-word detection during network activity
required_cases.evidence: Wake detection latency and false accept/reject rates remain inside profile limits while telemetry, OTA checks, or downloads are active.

required_cases.title: Wake-word detection during TTS or music playback
required_cases.evidence: AEC, barge-in, or documented fallback behavior prevents runaway self-triggering and preserves stop/interruption behavior.

required_cases.title: AEC and far-field behavior
required_cases.evidence: Measured near-field and far-field wake acceptance, false reject, and false accept results are recorded for normal room placement.

categories.title: Long-Duration Stress
categories.applicability: all supported profiles before production readiness

required_cases.title: Long-duration audio streaming
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint sustains repeated wake, capture, STT, response, playback, and idle cycles without memory growth or stuck sessions.

required_cases.title: Long-duration network stress
required_cases.evidence: Endpoint remains connected or recovers cleanly across repeated backend restarts, Wi-Fi drops, and MQTT/WebSocket churn.

required_cases.title: Thermal and power behavior
required_cases.evidence: Board temperature, current draw, brownout behavior, and enclosure constraints remain acceptable through sustained room-use testing.

profiles.operator_summary: Primary touchscreen/display target. Automated source/API coverage exists; physical audio, speaker, display, SD media, and OTA field validation are still required before release.

manual: Capture at least one wake-to-STT turn from the built firmware and confirm audio chunks reach `/api/voice/ws` with the expected endpoint id.
Confirm no duplicated post-TTS capture during the firmware cooldown window.
Say the configured wake word from idle and confirm the endpoint enters listening/capturing.
Confirm a below-threshold wake attempt is reported without starting STT.
Complete a voice turn and confirm audible playback starts, finishes, and emits playback completion telemetry.
Replay a cached TTS artifact from the UI/API and confirm endpoint playback.
Verify idle, listening, thinking, replying, error, and OTA display states on the panel.
Verify media-delivered UI assets render from the SD card after reboot.
Run an OTA push for the `esp_box_3` artifact and confirm the endpoint returns on the same id.
Deliver picture, sprite, sound, and manifest assets to SD media and verify inventory reports them after reconnect.
Send backend mute, unmute, and volume commands and confirm firmware state/telemetry changes.
Use local controls, if present on the device build, and confirm they do not conflict with backend commands.
Restart the backend during idle and active voice states and confirm the endpoint reconnects using the configured backoff.
Power-cycle the endpoint and confirm heartbeat, capabilities, and firmware version return in the operator UI.

profiles.operator_summary: Audio/LED-ring target with no display and NVS-only media storage. Automated source coverage exists for the PE board profile; physical XMOS audio, codec playback, LED ring, controls, and OTA field validation are still required before release.

manual: Capture a wake-to-STT turn from the PE microphone and confirm speech reaches the backend.
Confirm micro-VAD does not stream while the hardware mute is active.
Say the configured wake word and confirm the LED ring enters the wake/listening pattern.
Press the center button and confirm it starts a button wake session.
Complete a voice turn and confirm codec output at the PE speaker sample rate.
Confirm the wake accepted ding plays without replacing the following TTS response.
Confirm boot, idle, listening, capturing, thinking, replying, completed, muted, disconnected, and OTA ring patterns.
Confirm no panel display is expected for this profile and the operator UI labels the profile accordingly.
Run an OTA push for the `ha_voice_pe` artifact and confirm the endpoint returns on the same id.
Confirm media/SD features are reported as unsupported or NVS-only rather than silently failing.
Toggle hardware mute and confirm microphone streaming stops and LED state changes.
Rotate volume and color controls, including center-held color selection, and confirm they do not trigger voice sessions.
Restart the backend during idle and active voice states and confirm the PE reconnects using the configured backoff.
Power-cycle the PE and confirm heartbeat, capabilities, profile, and firmware version return in the operator UI.

unsupported_profiles.operator_behavior: Profiles not listed here are unvalidated. `firmware/build.sh` must reject unsupported `HEXE_BOARD_PROFILE` values before build or OTA push.
